_note: FROZEN 2026-11-19, written BEFORE any matter-files code existed (owner's go: 'go on P0 and P1 ... test on public court orders and synthetic documents'). Written by Claude, not a lawyer. Gold = the document and page (PDF) or paragraph (Word, counted from 1 over non-empty paragraphs) that holds the answer; more than one is listed when the answer is on more than one. Pages were found by reading the text (so some wording overlap with the documents is likely: a known bias in Claude's favour). Questions 40-42 have NO answer in the files (for a score floor, measured, not tuned on). Question 43 is about a document in ANOTHER matter (must return nothing from it). Do not edit after the first run; a change needs a new set.

metrics_declared_before_running.M1_extraction: every PDF page and Word paragraph is read; pages with no readable text are reported (the scan-only file's two pages and the letter's page 3 must be reported; no text page may be reported as unreadable); the text file is read whole.
metrics_declared_before_running.M2_retrieval: for questions 1-39: a gold location is among the passages handed to the answer model (k = the handover count fixed in the code before the first run). Reported for keyword-only, meaning-only (Voyage) and the combined search. One run; no tuning on this set after it.
metrics_declared_before_running.M2b_absent: for questions 40-42: the top score, to see whether a floor could separate them; not tuned on.
metrics_declared_before_running.M3_quote_check: the cases in quote_cases.json, verdicts fixed before the code.
metrics_declared_before_running.M4_injection: structural only (the model is not run): the planted instructions and delimiter-like strings stay inside the documents block, cannot close it, and the prompt clause tells the model that the documents are data.
metrics_declared_before_running.M5_leakage: question 43 returns no passage of matter B; the API test proves one person's or one matter's files are never searched from another.
